# `std::atomic_file` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/std/atomic_file.lani#L4)

Layer: `std`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Bounded sequential publication implemented in Lanius over TempFile and existing Linux descriptor calls. Keep one in-place manual owner; destination bytes are copied before effects. Replace/NoReplace commit syncs and closes the file once, renames once, immediately records Published/disarms deletion, then syncs the anchored directory. Receipts preserve NotPublished/Published/Unconfirmed visibility, confirmed bytes, current resources and separate primary/latest/cleanup errors. Cached commit is inert; explicit directory-sync retry never writes or renames. Failed removal retains recovery ownership; cleanup never unlinks the destination. Native Linux x86_64/kernel 7.0.0-38-generic/ext4 under /tmp passes owner 9, bounds 25, publication 6 and faults 26: 66 process invocations across four groups including baselines; preliminary smoke overlaps. A live-anchor Published checkpoint precedes ACK-controlled explicit sync retry. The bounds retry fixes only the oracle owned-fd write selector and reuses the unchanged probe ELF. Thirty-six CPU ledger controls and Rust --no-run admission are separate from native execution. Actual source/fd ownership is observed before exit. Parent mutation authority must be exclusive/cooperative; attempts/bytes are bounded, blocking time is not. No hostile-directory, network-filesystem, locking, universal power-loss or automatic-destructor guarantee; no new runtime binding or crypto implementation.
